text:
elena_harborwise: Hi team :wave: We just tried to finalize billing for Q1 and accounting says they won't accept the invoice unless it has an official HarborWise PO number and a cost center line. They're asking for the PO to include vendor tax ID and billing contact. Can you confirm what you need from our side?

support_jun: Hi Elena — sorry for the interruption. We show the invoice in our system flagged as "awaiting PO". Can you paste the PO header here or attach the signed PO? Also which billing contact should appear on the invoice? :eyes:

elena_harborwise: Thanks. Their procurement team requires the PO to include: PO number, HarborWise tax ID (GB123456789), cost center (CC-4321), and a billing email. They also want the PO signed by our CFO. We can attach a signed PDF, but curious if Redwood needs any specific field names/format.

support_jun: Got it. For Redwood's billing pipeline we need at minimum: PO number (plain text), legal entity name, tax/VAT ID, and a delivery/billing email. Cost center can be placed in the "reference" or "internal_notes" field. If you're attaching a PDF, send it to billing@redwood.ai and we can link it to the invoice.

elena_harborwise: Perfect — attaching a sample PO here (copied below). Will upload the signed PDF in an email too.

elena_harborwise: ```
PO#: HW-2026-994
Vendor: Redwood Inference LLC
Tax ID: GB123456789
Cost Center: CC-4321
Billing contact: accounting@harborwise.co
Signed by: Dana Morales (CFO)
```

billing_anne: Thanks Elena — I see the PO in our system now (pending attachment). Quick note: our invoice generator won't auto-populate the "cost center" unless you put it in the "reference" line, so please ensure that's visible in the PDF or in the email body. Also confirm whether HarborWise needs VAT broken out on the invoice or net-only.

elena_harborwise: They need VAT broken out. HarborWise is VAT-registered.

support_jun: Ok — workflow from our side: once we receive the signed PDF and the invoice is approved by Billing Anne, we can reissue the invoice with the PO number and cost center in the reference. ETA is same day if the PDF is attached to billing@redwood.ai and you post a message here confirming upload.

elena_harborwise: Uploaded the signed PDF to the email and cc'ed support_jun. File name: HW_PO_HW-2026-994_signed.pdf.

ops_bot: billing-system: Invoice 8921 status changed -> awaiting PO attachment (by elena_harborwise).

billing_anne: Received the PDF, thanks. I'm going to attach it to invoice 8921 and regenerate the invoice with VAT lines and the cost center in the reference. I'll post the new invoice URL here when ready. :white_check_mark:

support_jun: Appreciate it. If procurement asks for any special invoice numbering or PO acknowledgement language, ping us here and we can include a short cert line.

elena_harborwise: That's great, thanks both. One last question — does Redwood accept a scanned signature, or do you need a PDF with a digital signature?

billing_anne: Scanned signature is fine for our process. If they ever require a digital signature for compliance, we'll let you know.

elena_harborwise: Good to know. Thanks again — will confirm when payment is released. :pray:
